---
title: "Missing Data Mechanism Invistigation"
---


```{r}
data(airquality)
airquality
```

```{r}
summary(airquality)
```

```{r}
naniar::vis_miss(airquality)
```

```{r}
naniar::miss_case_summary(airquality)
```


```{r}
naniar::miss_var_summary(airquality)
```

```{r}
plot_var <- function(var) {
  ggplot2::ggplot(airquality, ggplot2::aes(x = {{ var }}, y = Ozone)) +
  ggplot2::geom_point() + 
  ggplot2::geom_smooth() +
  ggplot2::geom_vline(data = airquality |> dplyr::filter(is.na(Ozone)),
                      ggplot2::aes(xintercept = {{ var }}))
}
```

```{r}
plot_var(Solar.R)
```

```{r}
plot_var(Wind)
```

```{r}
plot_var(Temp)
```


```{r}
plot_var(Month)
```
